scenario: Every morning, scan open Zendesk tickets created in the last 24 hours, find tickets from the same requester email with near-identical subjects within 2 hours of each other, merge them into the oldest ticket and post an internal note listing the merged ticket IDs.
rule_hooks: duplicate-match window and subject similarity rule

scenario: Weekly, find Freshdesk tickets in 'Pending customer reply' status with no customer response for 10+ days, send the final reminder macro if not yet sent, otherwise close them with the 'auto-closed: no response' tag.

After the support ops team publishes a new tag taxonomy in a Google Sheet, re-tag all open and last-90-day solved Zendesk tickets by mapping deprecated tags to their replacements and removing retired tags.

When HR marks an agent as offboarded in the staffing sheet, reassign all of that agent's open Intercom conversations to their team's round-robin queue and Slack the team lead the list of reassigned conversations.
rule_hooks: agent roster with team and status

scenario: Scan the General Support queue for tickets whose body mentions invoice, charge, or refund keywords and move them to the Billing group, adding the 'misrouted' tag for routing-rule tuning.

At month end, compare Zendesk tickets tagged 'refund_approved' against QuickBooks refund receipts, mark tickets with a matching refund as solved with the refund reference, and list unmatched approvals in a reconciliation sheet for finance.
rule_hooks: ticket-to-refund matching on order ID and amount

scenario: Find helpdesk tickets with no organization assigned, look up the requester's email domain in the HubSpot company list, and set the organization field so account-level reporting is complete.
After customer tier changes in Salesforce, scan open tickets and update each ticket's priority and SLA policy to match the requester account's current support tier, noting which tickets now breach.
rule_hooks: support tier to SLA policy table

scenario: Daily, find tickets created from out-of-office replies, delivery-failure bounces, and marketing auto-responders, mark them as spam or delete them, and add sender addresses to a suppression list sheet.
Monthly, find Freshdesk contacts sharing the same email or phone, merge them into the record with the most ticket history, and preserve secondary emails on the surviving contact.

After a product rename, scan all published help center articles for the old product name and old URLs, update the text and links, and flag articles with screenshots of the old UI for the docs team in Asana.
rule_hooks: rename glossary and URL redirect map

scenario: Quarterly, find knowledge base articles not updated in 12 months with fewer than 20 views and referencing discontinued features, archive them, and post the list in the #support-knowledge Slack channel.
rule_hooks: article age, views, and discontinued feature list

scenario: Review all Zendesk macros, find ones that reference deleted groups, retired tags, or archived KB article links, and either repoint them per the mapping or deactivate them and notify the macro owners.

When engineering closes a duplicate Jira bug in favor of a canonical one, find all helpdesk tickets linked to the duplicate, relink them to the canonical issue, and update their internal note with the new status.
When a Jira bug moves to Released, find all pending-on-engineering tickets linked to it, send each requester the 'fix released' macro with the release version, and set the tickets to solved.
rule_hooks: Jira status and linked ticket field

scenario: Scan last quarter's tickets where the free-text 'Product area' field has inconsistent values (e.g., 'Billing', 'billing ', 'Invoices'), normalize them to the canonical dropdown values, and flag unmappable values for review.
Find tickets solved in the last 7 days where the CSAT survey was not sent due to a trigger outage, exclude tickets tagged no-survey or from VIP accounts, and send the survey to the rest.

Every Monday, scan all open tickets for first-response or resolution SLA breaches, tag them 'sla_breached', bump them to urgent priority, and post a breach summary by group to the support leads Slack channel.

Compare open return-authorization tickets against the warehouse returns-received sheet, update tickets where the item arrived to 'return received' and trigger the refund request, and chase customers with RMAs older than 30 days and no receipt.
rule_hooks: RMA number matching and return window

scenario: Weekly, find return tickets where a prepaid label was issued over 30 days ago and never scanned, close the RMA, mark the label voided in the tracking sheet, and email the customer that the return window has closed.
Each shift start, scan unassigned open tickets older than 4 hours and assign them to on-shift agents by language and skill using the shift schedule in Google Calendar, balancing current workload.
Find tickets whose language field is English but whose body is in another language, correct the language field, and move them to the matching regional queue.

Nightly, compare the VIP/strategic account list in Salesforce with helpdesk organization tags, add the VIP tag to newly strategic accounts, remove it from churned or downgraded ones, and log changes to a sheet.
rule_hooks: account tier and contract status in CRM

scenario: When accounts are marked churned in HubSpot, find their open non-billing support tickets, close them with a courtesy note, and keep billing or data-export tickets open, reassigning them to the offboarding queue.
rule_hooks: account status and ticket type exceptions

scenario: Weekly, pull the list of new Stripe chargebacks, match each to the customer's support tickets, tag matched tickets 'chargeback', attach the dispute ID, and create a ticket for chargebacks with no prior support contact.
rule_hooks: customer email and charge ID matching

scenario: Monthly per the data retention policy, find solved tickets older than 24 months, redact credit card numbers, SSNs, and attached ID documents, and record redacted ticket IDs in the compliance log sheet.

Work through the queue of verified data deletion requests, delete or anonymize the requester's helpdesk contact and tickets, skip records under legal hold, and update each request ticket with completion status.
rule_hooks: legal hold list and verification status

scenario: After an incident is declared on the status page, find open tickets mentioning the affected service created since the incident start, link them to the incident problem ticket, set priority to high, and send the incident acknowledgement macro.
rule_hooks: incident start time and affected service keywords

scenario: When an incident is resolved, find all tickets linked to the problem ticket, send the resolution message with the post-incident summary link, and solve them, except those where the customer reported additional issues.
rule_hooks: linked problem ticket and follow-up exceptions

scenario: After an SLA-breaching outage, review tickets requesting service credits, check each account's contract uptime commitment in Salesforce, approve eligible credits by creating Xero credit notes, and reply to ineligible requests with the policy explanation.
rule_hooks: contract uptime SLA and credit percentage table

scenario: Find tickets submitted with the generic form that are actually feature requests, switch them to the Feature Request form, populate the required fields from the ticket text, and move them to the product feedback view.

Monthly, group feature request tickets by requested capability, log each group as a vote on the matching Productboard or Trello card with account ARR, and solve the tickets with a 'logged for product' reply.
rule_hooks: feature taxonomy and ARR from CRM

scenario: Quarterly, list helpdesk agent seats with no login in 60 days, downgrade them to light agents or deactivate per the license sheet, ensure they have no open tickets, and report saved seat cost to the support director.
rule_hooks: seat license tiers and inactivity threshold

scenario: Reconcile the escalation-path Google Sheet with the current on-call PagerDuty schedule and HR directory, update departed or moved contacts, and Slack the support managers the rows that still lack an owner.
Scan tickets solved in the past 3 days where the customer replied afterward with an unresolved complaint, reopen them, assign to the original agent, and tag 'reopened_qa' for quality review.

Check open warranty-claim tickets against the product registration sheet, approve claims within warranty using serial number and purchase date, and send the out-of-warranty paid repair offer to the rest.

Before quarterly support reporting, scan solved tickets missing a contact reason or resolution code, infer the codes from the ticket conversation and macros used, and fill them in so the report sheet is complete.
rule_hooks: contact reason and resolution code taxonomy

scenario: Find Google Calendar and Zoom troubleshooting sessions booked from tickets that have since been solved or closed, cancel the meetings, and notify the attendees with a short note.
Monthly, find Slack escalation channels created per customer escalation whose linked ticket has been solved for over 14 days, post a closing summary and archive the channel.
rule_hooks: channel naming convention and ticket status

scenario: Weekly, review tickets tagged 'refund_pending_approval', auto-approve refunds under the agent approval limit within the 30-day window, route larger or late ones to the support manager in Slack, and update the refund tracker sheet.
rule_hooks: refund approval limits and refund window policy

scenario: After a support-address alias change, tickets sent to the consumer brand's address are landing in the B2B brand in the multi-brand helpdesk. Scan last month's tickets, compare each one's original recipient address against the brand–mailbox mapping sheet, and move mismatched tickets to the correct brand and group.

Agents promise free replacement shipments in tickets, but some are never created in Shopify. Cross-check tickets tagged 'replacement_promised' against zero-value Shopify orders, create the missing replacements or tag the ticket for review, and post the order number back to the ticket.

A help center restructure changed article URLs, leaving many articles linking to 404 pages. Scan all published articles for internal links, map old URLs to new ones using the redirect sheet, and rewrite the links, unpublishing nothing.

Tickets on hold awaiting a hardware vendor's diagnosis pile up. Compare on-hold tickets against the vendor's response log in Google Sheets, move tickets with a vendor answer back to open with the finding added as an internal note, and leave the rest on hold.

CRM sync created duplicate organizations in Zendesk (e.g., 'Acme Inc' and 'Acme, Inc.'). Group organizations by Salesforce account ID and email domain, merge each group's users and tickets into the canonical org, and delete the empty duplicates.
rule_hooks: CRM account ID as source of truth

scenario: Sales reps forward customer emails to support, so the rep becomes the ticket requester. Find open tickets whose requester has a company domain, take the original sender from the forwarded header, set that person as requester, and add the rep as a CC.

Many order-related tickets leave the Order Number custom field empty even though the customer quoted the number in the message. Extract candidate order numbers from ticket bodies, validate each one against Shopify for the same customer email, and fill the field only on verified matches.

CSAT ratings collected on tickets that were later merged into another ticket are double-counted in the support dashboard. Find rated tickets closed by merge, mark their ratings excluded in the CSAT export sheet, and note the surviving ticket ID.

Agents sometimes promise store credit as goodwill without issuing it. Compare solved tickets tagged 'store_credit' and their promised amounts against gift cards issued in Shopify, issue the missing or short credits, and reply to the customer with the code.

Customers resubmit the returns portal form, creating several return requests for the same order line. Group requests by order and SKU, keep the earliest approved one, cancel the duplicates so extra labels aren't paid for, and note this on the linked tickets.

'Where is my order' tickets stay open long after packages arrive. Look up each open WISMO ticket's tracking number in the carrier tracking export, send a delivery-confirmation macro and solve tickets showing delivered, and escalate any stuck in transit more than 10 days.

Several client companies rebranded and moved to new email domains, listed in a CRM change sheet. Update matching helpdesk user emails to the new domain (keeping the old address as a secondary identity) so replies on open tickets stop bouncing.

The support coverage calendar drifted from the approved staffing roster after a timezone change. Compare each Google Calendar shift event against the roster sheet, fix wrong times and assignees, delete shifts for agents not on the roster, and post a summary in the team-leads Slack channel.

The macro library has hundreds of entries, and many haven't been used in six months. Pull macro usage stats, deactivate shared macros with zero uses in 180 days unless they're on the protected compliance list, and log every deactivation to a sheet for owners to contest.

Customers on the web form often pick 'Urgent' for routine how-to questions. Re-evaluate urgent tickets from the past week against the impact/urgency matrix and the account's plan, downgrade those that don't qualify, and send a templated explanation to the requester.

A battery recall covers specific serial number ranges. Scan open and recent tickets for serial numbers in the recalled ranges from the recall sheet, tag them 'recall_2026_b', route them to the recall group, and send affected customers the recall instructions.

Screen-share support sessions recorded in Zoom must be deleted after 60 days unless the linked ticket has a legal hold. Match cloud recordings to tickets by meeting ID, delete expired recordings without a hold, and add an internal note to each ticket.

Refund-release and RMA authorization tickets wait in pending until the customer signs in DocuSign. Check each pending ticket's envelope status, move tickets with completed envelopes to the fulfillment group with the signed PDF linked, and send reminders on envelopes older than 7 days.

Billing dispute tickets stay open after finance voids or reissues the invoice in Xero. For each open dispute ticket, look up the referenced invoice, solve and notify the customer when it is voided or credited, and flag tickets whose invoice is still unpaid and overdue.

A sync outage left HubSpot ticket pipeline stages out of step with the helpdesk's actual statuses. Compare every open HubSpot ticket's stage with its linked helpdesk ticket and move each one to the stage given by the status-to-stage mapping.

Escalated tickets from enterprise accounts are supposed to CC the account's Customer Success Manager, but many don't. Look up each escalated ticket's account owner in Salesforce, add the CSM as a follower where missing, and post a digest to each CSM in Slack.

Zendesk's suspended-ticket queue holds legitimate customer emails alongside spam. Recover suspended emails from senders who are known users or belong to customer domains in the CRM, and delete the rest once they're older than 14 days.

Agent replies on dozens of tickets bounced because customer emails changed. Find tickets with a hard-bounce notification, look up an alternate active email for the contact in HubSpot, update the requester, and resend the last public reply.

Customers waiting on repairs receive loaner devices that are tracked in a Sheets log. Compare loaners past due against closed repair tickets, send a return reminder with a label link to customers whose repair is done, and flag loaners overdue 30+ days for billing.

The help center has piled up draft articles nobody finished. List drafts not edited in 90 days, reassign those whose author has left to the section owner from the KB ownership sheet, archive drafts whose topic is already published, and message the remaining authors.
rule_hooks: draft age, section ownership, duplicate topics

scenario: The help center moved from product-based to task-based sections. Move each published article to its new section and category according to the mapping sheet, fix articles left in the deprecated 'General' section, and report any article without a mapping.

Localized articles fall behind when the English source article is updated. Compare each translation's last-updated date with its source, mark outdated translations 'needs update', and add rows to the localization vendor's request sheet grouped by locale.
rule_hooks: source vs translation timestamps, supported locales

scenario: Premium customers buy prepaid blocks of technical support hours. Total the time logged on each account's solved tickets this month, update remaining balances in the hours tracker sheet, and email the account contact and CSM when a balance drops below 10%.

End customers who bought through resellers should be supported by the partner, not directly. Match open ticket requesters' domains against the reseller-managed accounts list, reassign those tickets to the partner group, and send the customer the partner's support contact.

The weekly QA scorecard sheet samples tickets for reviewers, but some sampled tickets were merged, deleted, or are still open. Remove the ineligible tickets from the sample, draw replacements from the same agent's solved tickets, and update reviewer assignments.

Goodwill credits are capped per customer per quarter by support tier. Total goodwill credits per customer from the credits log, flag customers over their tier cap, tag the issuing tickets for manager review, and send each team lead a list.

Agents get temporary 'login as customer' access to troubleshoot. Compare active grants in the admin access sheet with ticket status, revoke grants whose ticket is solved or older than 72 hours, and log each revocation as an internal note on the ticket.

Customers reply to closed tickets, which creates follow-up tickets with no reference to the original. Find recent tickets created as follow-ups, set the 'parent ticket' field, copy the parent's tags and assignee group, and assign the follow-up to the original agent if they are still active.

The incident review needs an accurate list of affected customers. Collect accounts from tickets tagged with the incident ID, dedupe them by CRM account, merge them into the incident's affected-accounts sheet with ARR and ticket counts, and remove rows whose tickets were retagged as unrelated.

Callback voicemails from the support phone line sometimes don't create a ticket. Match unhandled voicemails from the phone log to existing open tickets by caller number, attach the transcript where there's a match, and create new tickets for unmatched callers.

Engineering escalation tasks in Asana stay open after the support ticket is resolved. Check each open escalation task's linked ticket, close tasks whose ticket was solved more than 7 days ago with a closing comment, and ping owners of tasks with no linked ticket.

Open tickets keep CCing people who have left the customer's company. Check each open ticket's CC list against contact status in Salesforce, remove contacts marked 'left company', and add the account's current primary support contact where nobody remains.

Subscription cancellation tickets pile up while subscriptions keep billing. For each open cancellation ticket, check the subscription in the billing system, cancel it effective at period end if it's past the notice window, flag requests inside the minimum term for retention, and reply with the confirmation.

Customers often pick the wrong product model on the ticket form. For open hardware tickets, look up the serial number in the product registration sheet, correct the Product Model field where it disagrees, and re-route each ticket to that model's specialist group.

Damaged-in-transit tickets require a claim with the carrier within 30 days of delivery. Compare tickets tagged 'damaged_shipment' against the carrier claims sheet, add claim rows with photos and tracking for unfiled tickets still inside the window, and flag those already past the deadline.
